loci.rationale: Entry point for the partner-confirmed band: verify writes data['band'] into cases.confirmed and logs it as supplied 'for underwriting', establishing the purpose-bound field.
Only read of the confirmed band (band=c['confirmed'] or c['income']) is in the automatic score/underwriting decision branch — underwriting-only use.
Marketing audience predicate eligible_campaign selects on owner, restricted, stage and promotions/objection choices only; no income or confirmed band is consulted.
campaign() iterates officer's cases and queues promotion jobs solely via eligible_campaign, so audience selection cannot reach the confirmed band.
Promotion delivery emits a generic message ('A new loan offer is available.') with no income band, and is gated by eligible_campaign.
Owner-initiated promotion action is gated by eligible_campaign (permitted fields only), not by the confirmed band.
Offer payload exposes case id, email, amount, term only — the confirmed band is not carried into offer/marketing-adjacent output.
Preference store defines the permitted subscription/objection fields (promotions, objection) that marketing eligibility relies on, and cancels queued promotions on opt-out/objection.

output.path_summary: Partner band enters via action 'verify' (store.py:0157-0160) into cases.confirmed. The only consumer of cases.confirmed is the automatic score branch in drain (store.py:0131-0135), i.e. underwriting. Marketing audience selection (eligible_campaign, store.py:0100-0103) and delivery (drain promotion branch, store.py:0140-0142; action promotion, store.py:0165-0171) use only owner identity, promotions/objection choices and case eligibility (restricted, stage). Offer output (store.py:0111-0112) omits the band. Static review indicates the confirmed band is not used for marketing selection or delivery, consistent with the purpose-limitation predicate; no compatible-purpose or new-legal-basis path for marketing use of the band exists in the supplied source.
missing_boundaries: No execution or runtime observation was performed; assessment is static source review only.
portable() (store.py:0114-0116) exports the declared income field on a data-portability request; that is a separate data-subject right, not marketing use, and is outside this predicate.
No upstream or hidden implementation is inferred; only the supplied artifacts are authoritative.
Other GDPR duties (e.g. Article 6(1) bases, transparency) are out of scope for this rule.
